title: Human Body and Health
parentNote: This unit covers body parts, sense organs, food groups, and healthy habits. Make it fun by pointing to body parts and discussing healthy choices!
learnBullets: Know the **external body parts** and their functions
Learn about the **five sense organs** and what they do
learnItFirst:
**1. External Body Parts**

| Part | What It Does |
|------|-------------|
| **Head** | Contains brain, eyes, ears, nose, mouth |
| **Eyes** | Help us see |
| **Ears** | Help us hear |
| **Nose** | Helps us smell and breathe |
| **Mouth** | Helps us eat, drink, and talk |
| **Hands** | Help us hold, write, and do work |
| **Legs** | Help us walk, run, and jump |
| **Heart** | Pumps blood to all body parts |
| **Lungs** | Help us breathe |
| **Stomach** | Digests the food we eat |

---

**2. The Five Sense Organs**

| Sense Organ | Sense | What We Do |
|-------------|-------|------------|
| **Eyes** | Sight | See colors, shapes, people |
| **Ears** | Hearing | Hear sounds, music, voices |
| **Nose** | Smell | Smell flowers, food, perfume |
| **Tongue** | Taste | Taste sweet, sour, salty, bitter |
| **Skin** | Touch | Feel hot, cold, soft, rough |

---

**3. Types of Food**

- **Energy-giving foods** — Rice, bread, chapati, potatoes (give us energy to play and work)
- **Body-building foods** — Milk, eggs, fish, pulses (help us grow strong)
- **Protective foods** — Fruits and vegetables (keep us healthy, fight diseases)

---

**4. Good Habits for Health**

✅ Brush teeth twice a day
✅ Take bath daily
✅ Wash hands before eating
✅ Eat healthy food
✅ Drink plenty of water
✅ Exercise and play
✅ Sleep on time (8-10 hours)
✅ Keep nails short and clean

---

**5. Safety Rules**

⚠️ Do not play on the road
⚠️ Cross the road at zebra crossing
⚠️ Do not touch sharp objects
⚠️ Do not talk to strangers
⚠️ Do not play with fire or matches
⚠️ Always wear a helmet while cycling

---

questions.content: We use our ___ to see.
questions.why: Our eyes are the sense organs for sight

questions.content: We use our ___ to hear sounds.
questions.why: Our ears are the sense organs for hearing

questions.content: How many sense organs do we have?
questions.why: We have five sense organs: eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin

questions.content: Which body part helps us smell flowers?
questions.why: Our nose is the sense organ for smell

questions.content: We taste food with our ___.
questions.why: Our tongue helps us taste sweet, sour, salty, and bitter foods

questions.content: Which sense organ helps us feel hot and cold?
questions.why: Our skin helps us feel touch, hot, cold, pain, and pressure

questions.content: We should brush our teeth ___.
questions.why: We should brush our teeth twice a day — morning and night

questions.content: Which of these is a good habit?
questions.why: Washing hands before eating kills germs and keeps us healthy

questions.content: Milk helps us to ___.
questions.why: Milk is a body-building food that helps our bones grow strong

questions.content: We use our ___ to walk.
questions.why: Our legs help us walk, run, and jump

questions.content: Which body part pumps blood to all parts of the body?
questions.why: The heart pumps blood to all parts of the body

questions.content: We breathe using our ___.
questions.why: Lungs help us breathe in oxygen and breathe out carbon dioxide

questions.content: Food is digested in the ___.
questions.why: The stomach breaks down and digests the food we eat

questions.content: Which of these foods gives us energy?
questions.why: Rice, bread, and chapati are energy-giving foods

questions.content: Fruits and vegetables are called ___ foods.
questions.why: Fruits and vegetables protect us from diseases and keep us healthy

questions.content: Riya can see a red ball. Which sense organ is she using?
questions.why: Eyes are used to see colors, shapes, and objects

questions.content: Amit heard the school bell ringing. Which sense organ did he use?
questions.why: Ears are used to hear sounds like bells, music, and voices

questions.content: Which of these is NOT a safety rule?

options.A: Look both ways before crossing the road

questions.why: Playing on the road is dangerous — it is NOT a safety rule to follow

questions.content: Eggs, milk, and fish help us ___.
questions.why: Eggs, milk, and fish are body-building foods that help us grow strong

questions.content: Why should we drink water?

options.C: Water keeps our body hydrated and healthy

questions.why: Water keeps our body hydrated, helps digest food, and removes waste

questions.content: How many hours should a child sleep?
questions.why: Children need 8-10 hours of sleep to stay healthy and alert

questions.content: Meena touched ice. She felt cold. Which sense organ did she use?
questions.why: Skin helps us feel temperature — hot or cold

questions.content: Which of these should we NOT do?

options.C: Eat lots of chips and candy daily

questions.why: Eating junk food like chips and candy daily is unhealthy

questions.content: The brain is located in the ___.
questions.why: The brain is in our head and controls all body functions and thinking

questions.content: Which of these is a body-building food?
questions.why: Dal (pulses) is rich in protein and helps build our body

sections.name: Achiever's Corner
sections.leadingContext: These questions are a bit tricky. Think carefully!

questions.content: Rahul has a cold and his nose is blocked. Which sense will be affected?
questions.why: When the nose is blocked, we cannot smell properly

questions.content: Priya ate a lemon. It tasted sour. If she closes her eyes, can she still taste the lemon?

options.A: Yes, tongue can taste without eyes
options.B: Yes, but only if she holds it
options.C: No, she needs eyes to taste

questions.why: Tasting is done by the tongue, not the eyes. She can taste with eyes closed

questions.content: Why do we feel thirsty after running?

options.A: Our body loses water through sweat

questions.why: When we run, we sweat and lose water. Our body asks for water by making us feel thirsty

questions.content: Rohan can smell his mother cooking food from another room. How is this possible?

options.B: The smell travels through the air

questions.why: Smell travels through air from the kitchen to other rooms

questions.content: A doctor says, "Eat a balanced diet." What does this mean?

options.B: Eat as much as you want
options.D: Eat foods from all groups — energy, body-building, and protective

questions.why: A balanced diet includes all types of food — energy-giving, body-building, and protective foods
